description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointments of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial officers (mediators) who handle dispute resolution, establishing eligibility criteria for appointments, and outlining the nomination process through the Mediation Boards Commission - a judicial/legal administrative body. This fits Type 9 as it deals with judicial appointments and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the legal system.
